triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER nexus_document_notify_admins AFTER INSERT ON public.nexus_documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.nexus_notify_admins_on_document()

CREATE TRIGGER nexus_task_release_chain AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON public.nexus_tasks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.nexus_create_internal_release_chain()

CREATE TRIGGER nexus_diagnosis_report_release_chain AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.nexus_diagnosis_runs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'approved'::text) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status))) EXECUTE FUNCTION private.nexus_create_internal_release_chain()
